digest.component_or_area: ticket store migration and rebar editing framework
propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria bullets that are invisible to _count_ac_items (which counts only - [ ] items under Acceptance Criteria) and cannot carry operator-attested tags
Success Criteria bullets must be converted to - [ ] checklist items under Acceptance Criteria heading for P1 blocking floor and verifier compatibility
Migration script must process closed tickets by default and require explicit flag for open/in_progress tickets to avoid invalidating in-flight plan-review attestations
Dry-run revealed order-sensitivity bug where SC before AC caused heading duplication and corruption; fixed via order-agnostic _splice helper
Post-migration verification confirms zero Success Criteria headings remain, zero AC floor violations, and 106 tickets successfully migrated across two passes
